node.title: Getting start and end xml tags
node.author: corfuitl
node.doctext:
Hi

I am trying to implement a function to split a sentence with XML tags in 3 parts. To be more clear, I want to parse a sentence with XML tags so that I will not have the wrapping tags. Input sentences are:

Text here Text text here text here text here text here

Output should be

start: "", middle: "Text here", end: " " start: " ", middle: "Text text here", end: "" start: "", middle: "text here", end: "" start: "", middle: "text here text here", end: ""

I started my code but I don't think it's efficient. Any suggestions? a, b and c tags are self tags while d is always paired.

my $segment = $_; my $start =""; my $end =""; my $middle =""; while ($segment =~ /^(<[a|b|c] id=\".*?\"\/>)/ || $segment =~ /^(\s+)/){ $start .= $1; $segment =~ s/^\Q$1\E//; } while ($segment =~ /(\s+)$/ || $segment =~ /(<[a|b|c] id=\".*?\"\/>)$/){ $end = "$1$end"; $segment =~ s/\Q$1\E$//; } while ($segment =~ /^().*?(<\/d>)/){ ---- } print "start: \"$start\", middle: \"$middle\", end: \"$end\"\n";
